Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLIII﷓A OF 1977
ORDINANCE XLIII‑A OF 1977
PEOPLE S OPEN UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
An Ordinance to amend the People's Open University Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 9th May 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 9th November 1977, is hereby
published for general information :‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑ (1) This Ordinance may be
called the People's Open University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section I, Act XXXIX of 1914

ORDINANCE XLIII﷓A OF 1977
ORDINANCE XLIII‑A OF 1977
PEOPLE S OPEN UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
An Ordinance to amend the People's Open University Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 9th May 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 9th November 1977, is hereby
published for general information :‑
2. Amendment of section I, Act XXXIX of 1914.‑In the People's
Open University Act, 1974 (XXXIX of 1974), hereinafter referred to as the said
Act, in section 1, in subsection (1), for the words, comma and figure
"People's Open University Act, 1974" the words, comma and figure
"Allama Iqbal Open University Act, 1974" shall be substituted.

Amendment of section 2, Act XXXIX of 1974

ORDINANCE XLIII﷓A OF 1977
ORDINANCE XLIII‑A OF 1977
PEOPLE S OPEN UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
An Ordinance to amend the People's Open University Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 9th May 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 9th November 1977, is hereby
published for general information :‑
3. Amendment of section 2, Act XXXIX of 1974.‑In the said
Act, in section 2, for clause (p) the following shall be substituted, namely :‑
"(p) 'University' means the
Allama Iqbal University as renamed under this Act ;"

Amendment of section 3, Act XXXIX of 1974

ORDINANCE XLIII﷓A OF 1977
ORDINANCE XLIII‑A OF 1977
PEOPLE S OPEN UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977
An Ordinance to amend the People's Open University Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 9th May 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 9th November 1977, is hereby
published for general information :‑
4. Amendment of section 3, Act XXXIX of 1974.‑In the said
Act, in section 3,‑
(a) after subsection (1), the
following subsection shall be inserted, namely :‑
"(1‑A) The People's
Open University as established in accordance with the provisions of this Act
shall, on and from the commencement of the People's Open University (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1977, be renamed as the Allama Iqbal Open University'." ; and
(b) in subsection (3), for the
words "People's Open University" the words "Allama Iqbal Open
University" shall be substituted.
